observations.what: build_forest_hierarchy iterates forest.nodes, filtering by FILE_NODE_KINDS; FILE_NODE_KINDS is not defined in this chunk.
HierarchyNode is frozen, but to_dict returns a mutable dict; no deep copy is performed.
ForestHierarchy.content_sha256 calls _digest, which is not defined in this chunk.
build_forest_hierarchy uses REPOSITORY_NODE_ID and HIERARCHY_SCHEMA_VERSION, not defined in this chunk.
children_map returns sorted children; sorting by node.id ensures deterministic order.
root property uses next() and will raise StopIteration if no node matches REPOSITORY_NODE_ID.
build_forest_hierarchy raises ValueError if two forest nodes map to the same canonical path.
